Exploring Quito's Topography Through Paper-Cut Maps

2023Personal projectSole author

The challenge

Quito sits in a narrow Andean valley at 2,850 m, surrounded by volcanic peaks. Communicating its dramatic elevation changes through an artistic format that is both geographically accurate and visually compelling.

The approach

ArcGIS Pro was used to process Digital Elevation Model data for the Quito region, generating hillshade and contour outputs that formed the basis of the paper-cut design. The elevation layers were translated into cut levels representing distinct altitude bands, combining cartographic precision with a layered paper-cut aesthetic.

Key outcomes

  • Quito's complex Andean topography rendered as a layered paper-cut elevation map
  • Cartographic accuracy maintained throughout, with DEM data processed in ArcGIS Pro
  • Personal project exploring the intersection of GIS technology and artistic cartography

Built with

  • ArcGIS Pro
  • Cartographic Design
  • 3D Visualization
  • DEM Analysis
  • Hillshade Rendering
